19 years on site

Allin1 Group ADV has been designing and building for brands since 2007 — from a single signage workshop to full-service event, booth and billboard fabrication.

Every project moves through one team: design, materials sourcing, production and on-site install, so nothing gets lost in handoffs.

2007
Workshop founded, starting with illuminated signage.
2013
Expanded into exhibition booths and event builds.
2018
Added large-format billboard production and install.
Today
Full-service advertising fabrication across Cairo and beyond.
